title: Fairness Audit Playbook
description: A practical governance-oriented playbook for examining algorithmic fairness beyond aggregate bias checks, with attention to subgroup harm, intersectional patterns, and audit limitations.

title: AI Governance Research Notes
description: Conceptual and applied writing on algorithmic accountability, feedback loops, embedded evaluation, and the limits of static audits in high-impact AI systems.

title: Digital Transformation Failure Study
description: Graduate research examining how socio-political dimensions are marginalized in explanations of digital transformation project failure, especially when failure is reduced to technical or managerial causes.

title: Responsible AI Risk Review Framework
description: A developing framework for connecting fairness assessment, accountability documentation, and organizational risk review before and after AI system deployment.
